name: comp-589

frames.best_why: The account dropdown is open with three options and a tick on Personal.

tagline: Breadcrumb header whose account and project names open dropdowns to switch.
summary: A slim dark header with a two-part breadcrumb for account type and project, each opening a small dropdown, followed by Dashboard, Docs, API reference links, a gear and an avatar.
appearance: A slim dark header starts with two ghost buttons, Personal and Main project, each with an up-down chevron and split by a slash, then Dashboard, Docs and API reference links, a gear icon and a round avatar.
behaviour: Each breadcrumb button opens a small dropdown of account types or projects with a tick on the current choice. Picking one updates that label; the plain nav links only brighten on hover.
demo_content: Accounts are Personal, Team, Business; projects Main and Origin; links Dashboard, Docs, API reference.
search_phrases: docs header with settings and avatar
switch account and project from top bar
use_when: A workspace header must show and switch the active account and project while keeping docs links handy.
avoid_when: Both selectors are limited to a few fixed options each, and the nav links are static placeholders.
customise: Account and project options, defaults and nav labels are written in the file; the settings and user menus come from separate pieces.
weight_why: Two small selects, three links and two icon buttons.

a11y.note: Both selects are labelled; naming for the gear and avatar depends on the separate components used.

polish_why: Two working breadcrumb selects in a tidy bar; the option rows are small and tightly packed.
title: Breadcrumb Version Header
